# Leak scan allow-file (.github/ci/leakscan). Generic-pattern hits that were
# looked at and judged not to be a leak. Every line needs a reason; a line
# without one makes the scan fail closed. This file is public: never write an
# identifier here.
#
#   path  <glob>  <class>  <reason>     every hit of <class> in matching files
#   match <class> <regex>  <reason>     hits of <class> whose value matches the
#                                       whole regex, in any file
#
# <class>: a built-in class (private-ip, packed-private-ip, csrf-token,
# basic-auth, sap-session-cookie, sap-sso-cookie, config-password) or
# "generic" for all of them. A hit on the identifier list cannot be excused.
# Refused outright: a glob of only wildcards (**, *, **/*) and a regex that
# matches anything.
#
# CI reads this file from the pull request's BASE, so a new rule only takes
# effect once merged: add it in a pull request of its own, for review.

path  **/go.sum                       packed-private-ip  Module checksums (h1: base64 SHA-256). Four hashed bytes that read as 192.168 or 172.16-31 are chance.
path  **/package-lock.json            packed-private-ip  npm integrity hashes (base64 SHA-512). Four hashed bytes that read as an address are chance.
path  internal/tsgo/bundled/libs/lib.dom.d.ts  packed-private-ip  Vendored typescript-go (Apache-2.0, see internal/tsgo/README.md): words and Go identifiers decode as base64 to bytes that read as an address by chance.
path  internal/tsgo/bundled/libs/lib.webworker.d.ts  packed-private-ip  Vendored typescript-go (Apache-2.0, see internal/tsgo/README.md): words and Go identifiers decode as base64 to bytes that read as an address by chance.
path  internal/tsgo/diagnostics/diagnostics_generated.go  packed-private-ip  Vendored typescript-go (Apache-2.0, see internal/tsgo/README.md): words and Go identifiers decode as base64 to bytes that read as an address by chance.
path  internal/tsgo/checker/grammarchecks.go  packed-private-ip  Vendored typescript-go (Apache-2.0, see internal/tsgo/README.md): words and Go identifiers decode as base64 to bytes that read as an address by chance.
path  internal/tsgo/transformers/estransforms/esdecorator.go  packed-private-ip  Vendored typescript-go (Apache-2.0, see internal/tsgo/README.md): words and Go identifiers decode as base64 to bytes that read as an address by chance.
path  internal/tsgo/transformers/estransforms/esdecorator.go  private-ip  Vendored typescript-go: ECMAScript specification section numbers in upstream comments (four dotted numbers starting with ten).
path  internal/tsgo/transformers/estransforms/namedevaluation.go  private-ip  Vendored typescript-go: ECMAScript specification section numbers in upstream comments (four dotted numbers starting with ten).
